post.summary: generate a console access token for a Instance
post.description: Issues a short-lived (120s) JWT the frontend uses to open the console WebSocket directly on the worker. The token carries `console:read`, plus `console:write` when the user has that permission. Requires `instance:console:read`. The worker rechecks the token, session and current permissions with the manager every 10 seconds. Revoked read access or an expired token closes the socket; revoked write access blocks commands after the next check.
